text:
maya (PM): quick async check — Q3 OKR milestone: 'Runtime v3 dedicated capacity' status? what shipped vs slipped, and who owns next steps?

sanjay (Eng): shipped: autoscale policy basic + canary routing. pushed stable canary yesterday :tada:

taylor (Eng): slipped: quantized model verifications. still flaky on 8k KV cache for RNN-like traces. investigating root cause. ETA EOW? maybe +1 sprint.

lucy (Eng Platform): ownership clarify — sanjay landed autoscale, taylor owns quant tests, lucy+infra will handle rollout ops and traffic shaping.

maya (PM): tagging owners in case folks see this later @sanjay @taylor @lucy — please confirm next actions.

sanjay (Eng): confirmed. next actions: 1) merge autoscale PR to stable, 2) add failover policy to routing table, 3) update dashboard SLOs. PRs: <https://git.company/ri/runtime/pull/8124|#8124>, <https://git.company/ri/runtime/pull/8130|#8130>.

taylor (Eng): working on repro harness for quant tests, sending experimental logs to /shared/quant-debug. short command to run locally:
```bash
./scripts/run_quant_test.sh --model redwood-llama-8k --seed 42
```
please don't run scale tests on prod.

kevin (Product Eng): shipped product-facing stuff: updated model catalog entries and API docs for new ded. customers on trial have been migrated to canary. Noted one regressed eval on summarization testset (PR link in thread).

maya (PM): ok — shipped list: autoscale, canary routing, docs + catalog. slipped: quant verifications + one summarization regression.

lucy (Eng Platform): ops notes: temporary buffer plan = route 20% traffic to v3, fallback to v2 on latency > 400ms or 5xx. I'll add the policy before tomorrow's morning window.

sanjay (Eng): I'll add canary rollback playbook to the runbook. snippet for rollout policy:
```json
{"policy":"percent_split","v3":0.2,"fallback":"v2","latency_ms":400}
```

kevin (Product Eng): code review pings: need eyes on #8124 (autoscale logic) and #8152 (catalog update). tagging @taylor for eval regression.

taylor (Eng): ack, I'll pick up #8124 review after repro is stable.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: runtime-canary -> prod-canary at 2026-03-21T02:00Z (initiator: lucy).

maya (PM): risks & next steps: 1) get quant tests green (+owner taylor, target EOW), 2) roll out buffer policy (lucy, tomorrow), 3) docs + customer comms (kevin, PR merged), 4) cr reviews to clear (everyone).

sanjay (Eng): open blockers: need a perf trace from staging to compare kernel selection patterns. @lucy can you export?

lucy (Eng Platform): yes, exporting now to /ops/traces/1778881234.tar.gz, will ping when upload complete.

maya (PM): thanks — last ask: put short update in the weekly OKR digest by Friday morning, one-line shipped/slipped + owners. I'll compile. :thumbsup:
